This dynamic weaving process is self-contained and constantly progresses without requiring any input.

statement: This sketch creates a dynamic tapestry of colorful threads that weave across the canvas in continuous motion. Each thread moves independently with its own direction and color, leaving trails behind it as it flows. Where threads come close to each other, they form connections at precise 90-degree angles, creating a structured geometric pattern. The system maintains a constant flow of new threads entering the canvas while older ones fade out, ensuring the weaving never stops. The result is an ever-evolving pattern of intersecting lines that follows strict geometric rules, producing a visually compelling and mathematically constrained composition.
